messages.author: ef13d6499a420f45
messages.subject: Area constraints won't constrain
parts:
Hello fellow bears,
I've been running BiogeoBEARS with and without dispersal multipliers,
and my results (both the likelihoods and reconstructions) are exactly
the same. Is anyone having the same problem? I've tried different sets
of species, different area assignments, including or not null areas in
the model, and still always the same.

The part of my script that gives the dispersal constraint file is given by:

#Set up dispersal multipliers
DEC_run$dispersal_multipliers_fn = np(paste(addslash(getwd()),
"file.dispersalmultipliers", sep=""))

And my dispersal file is attached. I remember a post emphasizing the
file needs a blank line after the 'END', but this doesn't seem to be
the problem.
Thanks much!
Cheers,
Ivan.

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Area constraints won't constrain
parts:
Howdy Ivan!  It oughtta work if you use all these source commands to get all the updates (you have to use them each time you use library(BioGeoBEARS) ) found here:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeobears#script

library(BioGeoBEARS)
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_basics_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_classes_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_models_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_plots_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_readwrite_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_simulate_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_stratified_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wdfiles.com/local--files/biogeobears/BioGeoBEARS_univ_model_v1.R")
source("http://phylo.wikidot.com/local--files/biogeobears/calc_loglike_sp_v01.R")
calc_loglike_sp = compiler::cmpfun(calc_loglike_sp_prebyte)    # crucial to fix bug in uppass calculations
calc_independent_likelihoods_on_each_branch = compiler::cmpfun(calc_independent_likelihoods_on_each_branch_prebyte)

...at least it has for me lately.  Back last year I think I assumed constraints would always occur in time-stratified analyses (one could always do a "fake" time-stratification with two time periods with identical constraints matrices, of course).  But I believe I fixed it so it reads the constraints whether it's a non-time-stratified or time-stratified analysis.

But it's always possible I've screwed something up, if it still doesn't work you can send me the input files and I can double-check.

Cheers!
Nick

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Area constraints won't constrain
parts:
Just a note: the solution to this one was making sure this command:

BioGeoBEARS_run_object = readfiles_BioGeoBEARS_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)

...is at the right place in the script.  This function loads in the various dispersal multipliers, distance matrices etc. from the text files into the BioGeoBEARS_run_object -- without it, the program doesn't know those should be used.  I've been keeping it separate from other functions so that (a) errors/crashes specific to those files can be detected and (b) the files don't have to be loaded repeatedly if the same model is being run e.g. on a number of different trees.

I'll add a note to the script clarifying what this function does.

Cheers!
Nick

...which is a new record I think.
